class MonitorDaemon extends Thread {
    public MonitorDaemon() {
        setDaemon(true);
    }

    public void run() {
        while (true) {
            System.out.println("Monitoring memory...");
            try {
                Thread.sleep(2000);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
        }
    }
}

class UserRequest extends Thread {
    private String requestName;

    public UserRequest(String name, int priority) {
        this.requestName = name;
        setPriority(priority);
    }

    public void run() {
        System.out.println("Processing request: " + requestName);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            System.out.println(requestName + " step " + i);
            Thread.yield();  // Allow other threads to proceed
        }
    }
}

public class Server {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        MonitorDaemon md = new MonitorDaemon();
        md.start();

        UserRequest u1 = new UserRequest("Request1", Thread.MIN_PRIORITY);
        UserRequest u2 = new UserRequest("UrgentRequest", Thread.MAX_PRIORITY);

        u1.start();
        u2.start();

        u1.join();  // Wait for both threads to complete
        u2.join();

        System.out.println("All requests processed. Server shutting down.");
    }
}
lq.QUESTION_DESC:
Design a thread model for the above scenario. Implement:

  • Daemon thread for logging

  • Use of join() to synchronize shutdown

  • Thread priorities for urgent requests

  • Use of sleep() or yield() for load management
